question: Should CodexBar display Neuralwatt's active subscription kWh allowance alongside prepaid USD credits, or intentionally support prepaid balance only?
rationale: Both values describe independently usable quota pools, so code review cannot determine whether a simpler balance-only UI or a more accurate dual-pool presentation matches the intended product contract.

options.title: Show Both Quota Pools
options.body: Present prepaid USD credits and active subscription kWh as separate clearly labeled metrics so usable subscription capacity is never reported as exhausted.

options.title: Approve Balance-Only Semantics
options.body: Keep the narrower implementation but explicitly label it as prepaid-credit balance and document that subscription allowance is outside the supported display contract.

options.title: Defer Neuralwatt Support
options.body: Pause the provider until its quota model and exact-head live behavior can be validated without ambiguous exhaustion reporting.

recommendation.title: Show Both Quota Pools
recommendation.body: Present prepaid USD credits and active subscription kWh as separate clearly labeled metrics so usable subscription capacity is never reported as exhausted.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the hardening commits and the existing product-contract analysis for this provider.
